summary: Implemented per-task Git worktree isolation for Contract v2 mutations. Each task gets a deterministic branch and checkout inside the selected repository; approval-gated filesystem, terminal, Git and GitHub mutations resolve against that task root. Existing workspace edits are seeded into a new or retrying worktree with bounded size and generated/secret paths excluded. Release refuses dirty worktrees unless forced, and forced cleanup captures status, a binary patch and bounded untracked files under ignored evidence storage. Recovery marks missing checkouts orphaned without deleting branch or evidence metadata.

risks: Mutations without contractMutation.taskId intentionally retain the selected repository root for backward compatibility; new agent proposals should always include a task binding.
Worktree branches remain local until a later human-controlled merge or publication workflow.
Forced cleanup stores evidence under ignored local storage; operators should back up that directory if evidence retention is required across workspace deletion.
